name: Her Revenge
storyline:
A first-person psychological horror experience set entirely inside a sealed apartment building. You are thrown into the center of a massive, terrifying misunderstanding. Discover the horrific truth of Grandma's Story, and find a way to stop her from finding you.

Silence is Survival You are not alone. Grandma is always wandering around, and she is highly sensitive to sound. Because you cannot fight back, your only weapon is COMPLETE SILENCE. Every hasty footstep, clumsy interaction with the environment, or collision means immediate DEATH.

You must navigate carefully, keeping all the lights off so she doesn't see you. But be warned: she's smart enough to turn the lights on by herself. You must be completely attentive. A slight moment of carelessness and you are dead, dead, dead!

The Goal: You must first find out what happened and then END the madness. There's a secret room somewhere in the apartment, which will answer all your questions.
summary: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK
